verdict.rationale: Segment documents Engage Audiences, which group users by tracking events, traits and computed traits and sync them automatically to hundreds of destinations. That amounts to event-based rules driving downstream activation. Functions let custom JavaScript destinations process incoming data, but the evidence never describes an explicit event-trigger or rule-to-action automation engine. missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-triggered rules and actions (e.g., trigger conditions, filters, workflow or journey steps), detail on how Actions destinations map events to actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
